reference data: 583 calculators, 577 formula versions, 252 engine-proven, 47 canonical fields, 2 plans, 14 analyzers

anon holds no privilege on any public table or column

no client write path to value_records, calculation_records or billing/entitlement tables

trusted-server functions are executable by service_role only
sign-up (server trigger) creates account + profile, no grant; effective plan is free
A cannot read any of B's rows, and B cannot read any of A's
A cannot update B's rows (0 rows affected, data unchanged)

anon can read nothing and call nothing
a Free user can create one machine; a second is refused
a Free user cannot create two machines in one statement
A (Free, already has one machine) cannot add another
soft-deleting the machine (or its garage) frees the allowance; deletion cannot be undone to exceed it
a Premium user can create additional machines
a lapsed Premium user keeps existing machines (read/update) but cannot add more
a Free user cannot create a saved calculation (even on their own record)
a lapsed user cannot create or edit, but can still read and soft-delete
Premium create: machine is filled from the calculation; inconsistent links are refused
clients cannot change calculation_id/owner/deleted_at or hard-delete; soft delete is permanent
a Free user cannot save an engineering analysis
Premium save: version pinned, trust label fixed, inputs validated, links consistent

a client cannot self-grant, extend, alter, delete or truncate entitlements
a client cannot write or read server-only billing tables, nor call the server functions
pf_has_feature / pf_my_entitlement reflect only the caller
expired, future-dated, revoked and deactivated-plan grants confer nothing
even the server cannot rewrite grant history (guard, no delete, no truncate, no un-revoke)
webhook events are idempotent and immutable
subscription lifecycle drives exactly one grant: activate, replay, renew, cancel, resubscribe
billing integrity: one customer per account, subscription customer must match its account, unknown price refused
value_records: no client insert/update; no update/delete/truncate even for the server
calculation_records: no client insert/update; no update/delete/truncate even for the server
marine machine types and fields are refused for clients and the server
automotive machines (car, motorcycle, UTV...) remain fully supported
a user edits own display fields; identity/timestamps are server-controlled; avatar must be https
soft-delete functions require authentication and act only on the caller's active row
internal definers (allowance, link checks, sign-up) are not callable by clients
concurrent first-machine inserts by one Free user: exactly one succeeds (advisory lock)
